submission.natural_language_explanation: This pole fires retrospectively when a token continues an ongoing stretch of edited prose or reference apparatus: a subject pronoun (he, she, they) resuming the discourse subject after a complementizer, relativizer, semicolon or sentence boundary; a verb or noun phrase carrying the account forward (looks, circulated); or a join completing a compact reference link (a hyphen, comma or range words between year-tokens, a colon after a catalogue label such as Footnote, Appendix or No., © after Copyright, a period after an abbreviation). Its peak strength is graded by the surrounding frame rather than binary: full strength needs a rich lead-in or a complete reference line, the same trigger in a bare isolated fragment fires only weakly (a lone Appendix B line, a bare Rumors-that clause, or a short foreign copyright notice sit around 0.3-0.4), and the same token class outside any continuation frame (a colon introducing a shopping list or a clock time, a decimal point, a spaced score hyphen, full-word have for clitic ve, object him) stays near zero.

readings.explanation: This pole fires retrospectively when a token continues an ongoing stretch of edited prose or reference apparatus: a subject pronoun (he, she, they) resuming the discourse subject after a complementizer, relativizer, semicolon or sentence boundary; a verb or noun phrase carrying the account forward (looks, circulated); or a join completing a compact reference link (a hyphen, comma or range words between year-tokens, a colon after a catalogue label such as Footnote, Appendix or No., © after Copyright, a period after an abbreviation). Its peak strength is graded by the surrounding frame rather than binary: full strength needs a rich lead-in or a complete reference line, the same trigger in a bare isolated fragment fires only weakly (a lone Appendix B line, a bare Rumors-that clause, or a short foreign copyright notice sit around 0.3-0.4), and the same token class outside any continuation frame (a colon introducing a shopping list or a clock time, a decimal point, a spaced score hyphen, full-word have for clitic ve, object him) stays near zero.

It is a generic clause-or-document boundary marker firing on any punctuation or function word at a segment edge, predicting equal firing on clock-time colons, shopping-list colons, decimal points and spaced score hyphens.
It is a narrow lifespan-date hyphen detector with an unrelated contraction-tail offshoot, predicting silence on resuming pronouns, finite verbs, label colons and comma-joined years.
